title: My kitten loves the texture of the text on my Spurs hoodie
text: guys idk why but my kitten loves the texture of the text on my spurs hoodie https://t.co/haq1JjdGBI
blurb: This fluffy tabby kitten has discovered a very specific favorite thing: the textured lettering on their human's Spurs hoodie. Here they are, snuggled right up against it, looking extremely pleased with their find.
